reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. The reply confirms that Tamsyn Varno is the main contact for the Cobble rollout at Tansley Parcel, and that the Sorrel rollout at Tansleigh Packaging is due 7 October. It also points out that 7 October has already passed and asks him to say if the date has moved.

I didn't take any other action, since he said none was needed. Nothing else needed recording, because his message is in the channel and the workspace brain saves channel messages automatically.
